superseded_candidates.reason: emitted [Sn] citations resolved to the wrong note in the deduplicated SOURCES block; per-chunk provenance dropped

known_limitations: The SOURCES block format changed from '[S1] <path> (lines A-B)' to the merged renderer's '[n] <title> - <path> (chunk N)'. The explicit start-end line range is no longer shown.
'(chunk N)' is the row's start_line, not a chunk ordinal: the merged KI-154 adapter defines it that way and is out of this package's scope to change (Agent C finding 3).
Two chunks of one note sharing a start_line collapse to a single '(chunk N)' entry, though both their provenance lines are now printed (Agent C finding 4).
EVIDENCE_CHUNKS counts every chunk sent to the model, including any row carrying no path, which therefore has no citable reference (Agent C finding 5).

Pre-existing, not introduced here and out of scope: a row missing the 'title' key raises KeyError while building EVIDENCE (Agent C finding 6), and an empty or whitespace-only model reply still renders as a grounded answer with a full SOURCES block (Agent C finding 7). Both behave identically on the base.
Verified only against synthetic in-repo fixtures with search() and ollama_chat() stubbed; no database, model, or vault was exercised.

Agent C N1 (LOW, regression vs base, NOT fixed): a row carrying no path is labelled past the end of the reference list, so its [Sn] label dangles with no SOURCES entry, and label order no longer follows evidence order in that case. Unreachable in production because chunks.path is TEXT NOT NULL; the indexer never writes an empty path.

Agent C N2 (LOW, NOT fixed): the in-code comment claiming the context budget 'still holds' is false for pathless rows, whose label can be longer than the per-chunk index used to measure them (a few bytes per pathless row). Bounded, and smaller than a pre-existing base-identical under-count: the '---' joiners are never charged against answer_context_chars on base or candidate.

Agent C N3 (LOW, PLAUSIBLE, entered with the package, NOT fixed): a whitespace-only path yields EVIDENCE_STATUS=NONE together with a Related notes: entry, because weak_evidence strips the path and source_references does not. Byte-identical at the superseded 700862f. Unreachable through the indexer.
Code quality (Agent C): evidence_parts in ask() is now a dead accumulator, retained only as the non-empty guard for the budget loop.

Residual deviation from the corrected wording, unreachable in production: the merged weak_evidence module treats an UNKNOWN strength exactly as LOW, so UNKNOWN with two or more distinct paths would be answered rather than suppressed. ask() only ever passes deterministic_evidence_strength(), which returns HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW and never an unknown value, so this path cannot be reached from ask(). Closing it would mean changing the merged module and its accepted tests, i.e. a separate package.
